query:
SELECT survey_id, COUNT(*) as total_preguntas, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_reverse_scored = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inversas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_reverse_scored = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as normales
FROM survey_questions 
GROUP BY survey_id 
ORDER BY survey_id;
